categories_thin: Pest control / exterminating: no operator with a Perth Amboy street address surfaced; nearest are Woodbridge, Edison, South Amboy and Sayreville firms.
Masonry / concrete contractors: 15 results, none located in town (South Amboy, Fords, Woodbridge).
Hotels and motels: no independent hotel inside the town boundary in map results; the motels nearby are in South Amboy/Sayreville/Laurel Park.
Tree services: only one thin listing in town; the rest are Woodbridge/South Amboy firms.
Tutoring and test prep: dominated by national brands (Kumon, Sylvan, Mathnasium, JEI, Princeton Review) located outside town - only one independent local learning business found.
Dance and music schools: none located in Perth Amboy on map results; all were in Metuchen, Woodbridge, Edison.
Towing, moving and storage, security installers: very few with a Perth Amboy address - JJ Towing, Latino Shipping and MTI are the only ones found.
caveats: Town membership was tested by comparing each listing's map coordinates with the Perth Amboy municipal boundary polygon (from OpenStreetMap/Nominatim), so businesses in South Amboy, Woodbridge, Fords, Keasbey and Hopelawn were excluded even when they appeared in 'Perth Amboy' searches.

Yellow Pages, BBB, allpages.com, HomeAdvisor and Angi all block automated access (HTTP 403 / Cloudflare), so Google Maps listings plus each business's own website were the working sources. Directory-only businesses still appear here through their map listing.
National chains and franchises seen and deliberately excluded: Roto-Rooter, Rooter-Man, Maaco, Merry Maids, Rainbow Shops, Home Depot, and the YMCA-affiliated early learning centres.

Public-sector and non-commercial entities seen and excluded: Ignacio Cruz Early Childhood Center (Perth Amboy public schools), Community Child Care Solutions (non-profit referral agency), American Legion post (veterans organisation).

Many entries are owner-operated shops whose map listing shows only a street address with no website; the triage team should expect a share of disconnected numbers or home-based operators, especially in HVAC, painting, landscaping and restoration.

The eastern waterfront (Harbor Terrace, Riverview/near the Raritan) is about 8-9 miles straight-line from central Milltown, so it is inside the 10-mile radius but at the edge; everything listed is inside that radius.
data_gaps: Could not use Overpass API (blocked) or Yellow Pages/BBB (403), so no independent second directory was cross-checked against the map results - active_evidence is therefore mostly map-listing based.
Group C 'security system installers' and 'garage door / fencing / masonry' categories produced no in-town businesses, so those sub-categories are effectively empty rather than verified empty.

Businesses whose map pin sits just outside the town line but whose shopfront may be inside (Amboy Motel, Raritan Hotel, Amboy Tree Service, E&G Exterminators) were left out; worth a quick check if the owner wants full coverage of the border.
No headcount or revenue data was available for any business; Metropolitan Warehouse and R3 Metro South may be larger than the 500-staff cutoff and were flagged rather than dropped.
